note: The harnesses a try runs in the tenant sandbox (docs/harness-contract.md in the AgentMesh repository). Each is named by its own name, built from tenant-harness/ and listed here only after its image passed the harness contract check in the same build. The deployment manager builds a try that names a harness on that harness's image and on no other. {try.registry} is the tries registry the host names (DM_TENANT_TRY_REGISTRY). A customer's own harness image is listed the same way, after the same check.
